pages.text: The Celestial Item Vault stores items by type, and the Celestial Fluid Vault stores fluids by type. They begin with a small type limit. Right-click them with Chora Nectar to increase that limit; sneak-right-click uses as much of the held stack as possible.
Both vaults use Chora Nectar as their containment core.

Vaults can be opened by players and can also be accessed by logistics nodes, hoppers, and other automation. They remain normally mineable while resisting explosions, lava, Withers, and the Ender Dragon; sneak-use a compatible wrench to recover one instantly.

Vault terminals support display-name search and quantity, name, or mod sorting. In an Item Vault, empty-hand left-click takes a stack, right-click takes one, and Shift sends it directly to inventory; with a carried stack, left-click inserts all and right-click inserts one. A Fluid Vault uses fluid-capable containers for filling and draining.

Sky Filter Lists store exact item, fluid, and supported chemical samples in 18 ghost slots. They can use a whitelist or blacklist and can choose whether extra data and durability must match. Tag Filter Lists can filter by item tag, fluid tag, or source mod.

Placing a list in a node face filter slot, or right-clicking a simple-pipe endpoint with it, copies rules without consuming the item. Later edits to the original do not update copied rules. Extracting items from an external network requires a whitelist containing concrete items.
